metadata.title: [TESTING]: Add MCP protocol e2e tests via mcp-cli
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Add 22 end-to-end MCP protocol tests using IBM's [mcp-cli](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-cli) client against a live ContextForge instance
- New `make test-mcp-cli` Makefile target — no LLM provider or API key required
- Tests cover the full MCP protocol stack via both mcp-cli commands and raw JSON-RPC over `mcpgateway.wrapper` stdio transport

### What's tested

| Category | Tests | MCP Operations |
|---|:---:|---|
| mcp-cli connectivity | 2 | ping, servers |
| mcp-cli tools/list | 5 | JSON validation, field checks, schema types, gateway discovery |
| mcp-cli resources & prompts | 2 | resources/list, prompts/list |
| JSON-RPC via wrapper stdio | 11 | initialize, tools/list, tools/call (5 tools), error handling, concurrent requests |
| Protocol coverage | 2 | All discovery methods, server capabilities |

### Configuration

```bash
# Default — docker-compose stack on :8080
make test-mcp-cli

# Override gateway URL
MCP_CLI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4444 make test-mcp-cli
```

Closes #3315

feat(testing): add MCP protocol e2e tests via mcp-cli

Add 22 end-to-end tests that exercise the MCP protocol through IBM's
mcp-cli client and raw JSON-RPC over mcpgateway.wrapper stdio transport.
No LLM provider or API key required — all tests operate purely at the
MCP protocol level against a live ContextForge instance.

Tests cover: initialize, tools/list, tools/call (5 tools), resources/list,
prompts/list, concurrent requests, error handling, and server capabilities.

Closes #3315
